title: AI-Assisted Proof & 6-Kernel Lean 4 Formalization of the Theta and Valley Delta Conjectures
whyItMatters: Nankai University combinatorialists working with ChatGPT proved the touch-refined Theta conjecture—implying the open valley Delta conjecture of Haglund, Remmel & Wilson—with a 6-kernel-checked Lean 4 library.
summary: Released on GitHub in November 2026 (github.com/qiudun123/theta-conjecture), five combinatorialists at the Center for Combinatorics, Nankai University (including Dun Qiu) credited ChatGPT with assisting proof development of the touch-refined Theta conjecture of D’Adderio, Iraci, and Vanden Wyngaerd, which connects symmetric-function Macdonald/Theta operators to parking functions with decorated rises and contractible valleys. As immediate corollaries, the theorem settles the long-open valley version of the Haglund–Remmel–Wilson Delta conjecture and the generalized valley Delta conjecture of Qiu and Wilson. The core touching and summed Theta identities were formalized in Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib (849 files, zero sorry, zero warnings) and passed full build, axiom audit, and six-kernel replay.
technicalHighlights: Proves the touch-refined Theta conjecture in algebraic combinatorics, implying the open valley Delta conjecture and its generalized version.
Formalized in Lean 4.35.0 with Mathlib (zero sorry, warningAsError) and verified via full six-kernel replay.
Cited in Wolfram MathWorld’s Macdonald Polynomial entry as an AI-assisted resolution with formal Lean verification.
caveats: The Lean formalization certifies the touching and summed Theta identities directly; the Delta-operator translation corollaries (1.5(2)–(3)) are proved in the manuscript rather than formalized in Lean.
